title: 有馬記念の後に・皇帝君臨

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race ends amid thunderous applause, and Symboli Rudolf and Maruzensky congratulate one another on a battle well fought.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Reawakened to the thrill of racing, Symboli Rudolf pledges to share her joy with every Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, at the press conference, she outlines her dream as Emperor to the world. In this moment, the Emperor is truly born.
